tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal legs ldan nag po trak+shad lcam dral gyi

gtor chog zhes bya ba bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal legs ldan nag po trak+shad lcam dral gyi gtor chog ni/ gtor ma dpal gtor bshos bu zlum po dmar gyi brgyan pa mchod pa dang bcas bshams/ dus bzang por bsnyen pa la sogs pa'i skabs/ thun gtor gru gsum de yang bshams/ rgyun du thun gtor grub na legs mod ma grub kyang mi 'gal/ de nas yi dam gyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i bzlas pa cung zad bya/ mchod pa gtor ma byin rlabs yid dam gang byed kyis lugs bzhin byed/ de nas/ oṃ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ rang gi mdun du hūṃ las bsrung 'khor gyi nang du/ dur khrod chen po'i dbus su bh+rūṃ las phyi rin po sna tshogs las grub pa/ gru bzhi pa/ nang thod mkhar 'bar ba'i gzhal med khang*/ shar mi'-i thod pa'i rtsig pa/ lhor rta'i thod pa/ nub spre'u thod pa/ byang lug gi thod pa'i rtsig pa zlum po/ de'i nang du gru gsum nag po bdun brtsegs/ lcags kyi mkhar zung drug pa dbus su mi ro rta ro gcal du bkram pa/ gser gyi khri dang*/ pad nyid brtsegs pa'i gdan la/ raṃ las dpal ye shes kyi mgon po sku mdog dmar nag srin po khros pa'i gzugs/ sdang mig 'bar ba'i spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa/ sma ra dang smin ma/ dbu skra kham nag 'bar zhing lding pa/ g.yas kyi zhal shwa na mu kha ser po shel mig can/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis na dug gi sdong po me 'bar ba dang*/ bdud kyi zhags pa nag po/ g.yon gnyis na khram shing dang thod pa snying bcas 'dzin pa/ dar nag gi 'jol ber dred mo'i bcing slag / seng ge'i lpags pa'i go slag can dang*/ gser gyi ska rags/ sag ti'i l+h+wam/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan/ thod rlon gyi do shal la sogs pa'i rgyan dang cha byad rdzogs pa/ bdud rta nag po rting dkar la chibs pa/ khams gsum 'dar zhing skrag par byed pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/

/ de'i g.yon du bh+yoḥlas dpal ldan lha mo re ma ti/ ma mo yongs kyi gtso mo/ nag mo spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas na ral gri dang zhing lpags/ g.yon gnyis na thod khrag dang ne'u le bsnams pa/ glang chen lpags pa'i stod g.yogs dang*/ ba glang spags pa'i smad g.yogs can/ re lde'i sham bu dang*/ sbrul rigs bzhi'i ska rags dang*/ lte ba nas nyi ma dang*/ spyi gtsug nas zla ba 'char ba/ dre'u rta rkang gsum la chibs pa/ khrag mtsho'i dbus su me rlung 'tshubs ma'i dkyil na bzhugs pa/ de ltar lcam dral gnyis kyi sku'i 'khor du sprul pa'i mon pa pho bdun mo bdun/ las byed shwa na bdun/ gnod sbyin brgyad lcags kyi bya khra brgyad kyi gzugs 'dzin pa/ gshin rje brgyad/ stagagazigs/ dom/ dred/ 'phar ba/ seng ge spyang khyi brgyad du sprul pa/ bdud rgyal nyi khri chig stong lha dmag 'bum ste lha ma srin sde brgyad rnams sprin dpung 'khrigs pa ltar 'khod par gyur/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ 'dod rgyal khang dang*/ u tsa la'i dur khrod dang mu le steng la sogs pa nas/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po lcam dral 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sngon tshe shakya seṅga'i spyan snga ru/ /lha chen khyod kyi ji ltar dam bcas bzhin/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i las la spyan 'dren na/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ hūṃ lha min dmag tshogs g.yul bzlog cing*/ /lha dmag dkar po'i dbugs 'byin pa/ /lha chen dpal 'bar 'khor bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /oṃ badz+ra bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ rgyal ba rigs lnga'i dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan/ oṃ shrī mahā ka la trak+shad mahā ka la sing+nghi yaṃ du dza dzaḥ zhes gtso bo dang*/ oṃ ro ru ro ru dri tsa pa la a shug me ma hūṃ ma bh+yo dza dzaḥ

zhes lha mo'i sngags te mgon po'i phyed lha mo'i grangs su bshad/ de nas gtor ma 'bul te/ oṃ mahā ka la tri yaṃ dzaḥ sa ma ya sa ma lo ki ni mun bh+yo hūṃ phaṭa/ bā ling e dam grih+na kha kha khā hi khā hi bhuñja ho/ rak+ta pi ba to sa ma ya swāhā/ oṃ de bi ma hā ka li re ma tri e daṃ bā ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi mahā pañca a mṛ ta la kha hi/ mahā rak+ta la khā hi/ zhes lan gsum mam/ lnga'am/ bdun la sogs pas phul/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po mahā ka la/ rnal 'byor gyi dgra lha bdud 'dul gyi dbang phyug /dug gsum kyi sman pa/ rig 'dzin gyi srog shing*/ gtsug lag khang dang dkyil 'khor gyi srung ma/ lha yi ded dpon chen po srog bdud nag po thod pa'i phreng ba can 'khor dang bcas rnams ba ling rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig khā raṃ khā hi/ dpal ldan gnyan gyi re ma ti/ /bdud kyi yum la gshin rje'i lcam/ /nag mo dre'u la bzhon pa/ /gcer bu bong bu la bzhon pa/ /mgyogs ma rlung la bzhon pa/ 'khor nag mo 'bum dang bcas pa rnams ba ling rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /kha raṃ khā hi/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gis nang mchod 'bul/ hūṃ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur byon srog bdud ma rung ba/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul thabs kyi gtso/ /drag po'i zhal la gtum pa'i sku/ /srin po'i gzugs kyis gdug pa can/ /tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste/ /grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jigs par byed/ /gtum po khyod la bdag bstod do/ /bh+yoḥ ma yi nang nas ma gcig ma/ /sring gi nang nas srid gcig ma/ /dpal ldan gnyan gyi re ma ti/ / bdud kyi yum la gshin rje'i lcam/ /ma bcos chos sku bde ba chen po ni/ /srid dang zhi bar mi gnas mnyam pa nyid/ /yon tan 'phrin las 'tshams pa'i skur ston pa/ /dpal dang ldan pa'i lha mo khyod la bstod/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/

/ sogs nas/ kun 'grub shog ces pa'i 'dod don zhu/ thun gtor yod na skabs 'dir 'bul te/ hūṃ srid gsum dbang bsgyur mgon po yab yum dang*/ /stobs ldan pho nya mngags gzhugs 'khor dang bcas/ /shin tu 'jigs khros drag la rngam pa'i gzugs/ /rno ba'i mtshon 'dzin mgyogs pa'i shugs can rnams/ /zag med bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /sman rag phud kyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /dza gad dpa' bo'i sman phud= /dzam bu ṭa ka'i zhal zas= /dam nyams dgra bo'i sha khrag= /sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag gnyan por 'bul/ /da bcol legs pa'i gsol 'debs gnyan por bzhes/ /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /'gal rkyen nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang*/ khyad par sangs rgyas bstan pa skyong ba dang*/ /bla mas bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /rgyal ba'i bka' dang dam tshig bden pa bzhin/ /byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad byed pa yi/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs la sogs/ /thams cad rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod/ /bstan pa rgyas pa'i las 'di myur du sgrub/ /rnal 'byor bcol pa'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ / ces 'dod don zhu/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ brtan bzhugs/ smon lam rnams gang 'grub bya/ zhes dpal ye shes kyi mgon po lcam dral gyi gtor chog rgyun gyi nyams len zhes bya ba 'di yang sa skyong gzhon nu dam pa'i mnga' bdag kun dga' rab brtan dbang gi rgyal po'i bkas bskul nas/ tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// //sngon tshe bla ma gong ma'i spyan snga ru/ / chos bzhin sgrub par mdzad pa'i gang zag la/ /bar chad bsrung zhing skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ / mthu ldan trak+shad chen po'i bkra shis shog /dge'o// // 'di bris dge bas nges don bstan pa'i mi mthun phyogs thams cad gzhom pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ shu bhaṃ// bkra shis//
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - PAGE 180 -- PAGE 179 -- PAGE 176 -
